trends.label: AI in Fintech
trends.detail: The integration of AI in fintech is on the rise in India, with companies like Paytm and PhonePe leveraging AI for personalized services. This trend matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing demand for AI product management skills in the fintech sector.

trends.label: Digital Banking
trends.detail: Digital banking is becoming increasingly popular in India, driven by the government's push for digitalization and the growing adoption of mobile banking services. This trend is crucial for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers with expertise in digital banking and core banking migration.

trends.label: Conversational AI
trends.detail: Conversational AI is gaining traction globally, with companies like Google and Amazon investing heavily in chatbot technology. This trend is relevant for the candidate as it highlights the growing importance of conversational AI in fintech and the need for product managers with expertise in AI product building and prompt engineering.

trends.label: Regulatory Compliance
trends.detail: Regulatory compliance is becoming a major focus area for fintech companies in India, with the RBI introducing new guidelines for digital lending and data protection. This trend matters for the candidate as it emphasizes the need for product managers with expertise in regulated environments and change governance.

trends.label: Cross-Geo Collaboration
trends.detail: Cross-geo collaboration is becoming increasingly important in the fintech sector, with companies like Wells Fargo and Citibank operating globally and requiring product managers to lead teams across different geographies. This trend is relevant for the candidate as it highlights the need for product managers with expertise in cross-geo Scrum leadership and release management.

certifications.name: Certified Product Manager (CPM)
certifications.provider: Association of International Product Marketing and Management (AIPMM)
certifications.why: The CPM certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in product development, launch, and management. It is particularly relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like product ownership, backlog management, and user-story definition.

certifications.name: Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
certifications.why: The CSM certification is highly valued in the industry as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in Scrum framework and Agile methodologies. It is relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like cross-geo Scrum leadership and release management.

certifications.name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
certifications.provider: International Information Systems Security Certification Consortium (ISC)²
certifications.why: The CISSP certification is highly valued in the fintech sector as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in information security and risk management. It is relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like data protection and regulatory compliance.

certifications.name: Certified Data Scientist (CDS)
certifications.why: The CDS certification is valued by hiring managers in 2026 as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in data science and machine learning. It is particularly relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like AI product building and prompt engineering.

certifications.name: Certified Fintech Professional (CFP)
certifications.why: The CFP certification is highly valued in the Indian fintech sector as it demonstrates a product manager's expertise in fintech and digital banking. It is relevant for the candidate as it covers topics like core banking migration and loan origination.

news.headline: RBI Introduces New Guidelines
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has introduced new guidelines for digital lending, emphasizing the need for fintech companies to ensure transparency and fairness in their lending practices. This development matters for the candidate as it highlights the growing importance of regulatory compliance in the fintech sector.

news.headline: Paytm Launches AI-Powered Chatbot
news.summary: Paytm has launched an AI-powered chatbot to enhance customer experience and provide personalized services to its users. This development is relevant for the candidate as it demonstrates the growing adoption of conversational AI in the fintech sector.
